question: Which packets and multiplicities belong to ordinary Blackbird Skill/Burst casts?
stop_condition: Identify packets/multiplicities from saved descriptions and native arrays; use a disclosed bounded timing hypothesis if intervals are absent.
return_condition: New timing/reachability evidence changes Netherplume Rite 4x Skill_Damage or Requies Animarum 9x UltraSkill_Damage, Malice gauge or Evolve forms.
decision: Netherplume Rite describes 4 instances (100% * 4 at Lv1), matching native Skill_Damage (4 hits). Requies Animarum describes 9 instances (46.7% * 9 at Lv1), matching native UltraSkill_Damage (9 hits). Require each action's primary packet; schedule children once after admission with the admitted effective native coordinate. Each hit settles independently; Requies Animarum team ATK (+20%), A4 team DMG (+12%), and A6 Psyche DMG (+25%) buffs trigger consistently.
timing_hypothesis: blackbird.skill_burst_packets_v1: ordered coincident delivery on target zero at selected primary impact time. This supports packet totals and ownership, not native frame timing. Same-time delivery precedes queued gear callbacks; timing-sensitive results retain this assumption.
checks: Independent content damage oracles: at 1000 ATK/DEF.5/RES0, Skill levels 1/8/effective9 total 2000/1, 3428/1, 5702/1 (with A2 ratio addition 5428/1 at Lv8); Burst levels 1/8/effective9 total 12609/5, 4320/1, 50328/5 (with +20% ATK buff).
Pending horizons, off-field ownership, dead/lethal targets, rejected energy admission and alternate primary are checked. Strict requires matching hypothesis acceptance.

Description and native arrays agree at all nine levels. Public two-Skill/one-Burst rotation produces 17 hits and spends 100 energy once; CLI/WASM/Worker agree. Full content, relevant character/gear web suites, replay and modeled awakening verifier pass.
No full kit/readiness claim. Normal chains, Evolve stance transformations, Malice gauge consumption and full awakening mechanics remain pending.
